snippet.title: Battle for Krasnodar Campaign Trailer for DCS World
snippet.description:
Battle for Krasnodar is a story-based campaign that will test your air-to-air and air-to-ground skills in a variety of missions while you confront the US forces in the emerging conflict. 

Your Mig-21 bis squadron is tasked to defend the region of Krasnodar from the invasion of UN troops that support the UN resolution for the Independence of Soviet Union provinces. The UN response is moderate, however the Soviet forces in the region are facing supply problems due to the rapid destabilization of the Soviet Union. The resources are limited and often the VVS forces are suffering from the lack of support. As a front-line fighter squadron, you will have to move between airbases as the conflict evolves. 

Note: Mig-21 bis module is required to be installed for this campaign. 

Campaign features: 
25 story-driven missions
Over 400 voiceovers
Late 1970’s units set.
Full scale conflict that will progress throughout the campaign. 
Large variety of missions, CAP, CAS, Intercept, Escort, Anti-ship.
Detailed briefings, kneeboard files  and supporting documentation for each mission.
